item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i lha rgyal g.yung drung bstan pa rgyas pa'i pad tshal
item.coloph: de ltar rig brgya'i bdag nyid lha mchog rig 'dzin stong rgyung sgrub pa'i cha lag lha rgyal g.yung drung bstan pa rgyas pa'i pad tshal 'di/ tshe dbang bde chen snying pos shar grol smin gling du/ 'phral du bgyis pa 'dis kyang dge legs phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
